editorial:
Imagine being so bad at hunting that your own tribe kicks you out for being a loser. That is exactly where you start with these two guys who have no idea how the world works. You get to follow them as they wander through a prehistoric land, meeting weird people and stumbling into famous biblical stories by accident. The vibe is totally silly and doesn't take itself seriously at all. It feels like a giant sketch comedy show where the characters are just trying to survive while acting like complete idiots in a world that is just starting to develop.

Jack Black and Seth Rogen have great chemistry, and their goofy arguing is the best part of the whole experience. While some of the jokes might feel a bit dated now, the fast pace keeps you from getting bored. If you are in the mood for something light that doesn't require any brain power, you should definitely check this out. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp look, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this laugh-fest handy.
endingExplained: After a wild ride, the duo ends up in the middle of the biblical story of Sodom and Gomorrah. You see them accidentally help save people before the cities are destroyed by fire. In the end, they finally find their way back home. They are welcomed back by their tribe because they now have the knowledge and status of world travelers, proving that being a lazy outcast can actually lead to a great adventure.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slapstick humor and doesn't mind a ridiculous plot.
